changelog:
What's new in v5.0.10:
- Eight material themes with custom icons, light/dark modes and upgraded Liquid Glass.
- Force Select improvements for selection, editing and eligible local-file printing.
- WhatsApp browser recovery, health-check and single-window improvements.
- Session persistence and PDF preview performance improvements.
Published animated installer: clean installations only; legacy migration remains unverified. The separate local upgrade-fix installer and later V4 sidebar spacing change are not included in this published asset.
